title: Relics & Artifacts
description: Every journey holds something worth discovering.
body:
# Relics & Artifacts

### Collect Charms & Relics

Find magical artifacts and equip unique charms that grant useful abilities for exploration, movement, survival, and more.

[![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1321365/description_19767e94-ef82-4569-92c6-b1e8b60e6e07.png)](https://discord.gg/XgH4EpyPD2)

![vs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Ny4hiPCS/images/8b0ea67f22770f84f9a3315be35f1dc22842297a.png)

The world is full of places left unexplored, treasures left undiscovered, and secrets waiting beneath the surface.

![v4](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Ny4hiPCS/images/5282791ed1dfe8198697e8ce57009e9d0cca2287.png)

Relics & Artifacts expands Minecraft's sense of adventure by introducing unique structures, powerful charms, rare relics, and rewarding discoveries scattered throughout the world. From forgotten ruins and mysterious landmarks to dangerous locations filled with valuable loot, every journey can lead to something unexpected.

## Features

### Explore New Structures

![Sky Monolith](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Ny4hiPCS/images/f19fe196f9ebd71101d3afe742121a457f443986.png)

Discover a variety of handcrafted structures hidden across the world. Some contain valuable rewards, while others may present challenges worth overcoming.

![V3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Ny4hiPCS/images/a30d1cdc4827398f452fbd2cec5478d51e650400.png)

### Hunt for Rare Treasures

Search through ancient ruins, abandoned locations, and forgotten places to uncover relics and materials hidden from time.

### Vanilla-Friendly Design

Relics & Artifacts is designed to feel like a natural extension of Minecraft, adding new reasons to explore without overwhelming the core experience.

## Why Explore?

Because the next hill might hide a forgotten shrine.

Because a distant silhouette on the horizon might be an ancient monolith.

Because every structure tells a story.

And because every journey holds a secret waiting to be found.

*Some discoveries are better experienced than explained.*
